```{r setup}
#| include: false
source('helpers.R')

metals.df <- getPreciousMetals(precious_metals, params$currency)
start.date <- head(metals.df$date, 1)
end.date <- tail(metals.df$date, 1)
forecast.days <- 90

# package version from DESCRIPTION for report footer/cover
pkg_version <- tryCatch(as.character(read.dcf('DESCRIPTION', fields = 'Version')[1]), error = function(e) NA)
```

Data: last `r nrow(metals.df)` trading days of COMEX/NYMEX futures from Yahoo Finance, `r format(start.date)` to
`r format(end.date)`. Forecasts use `auto.arima()` over a `r forecast.days`-day
horizon.

--

## Executive summary {.unnumbered}

Report version: `r pkg_version`  
Generated: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")`

Below is a concise summary of the most recent prices and simple statistics
for each metal (last observed price, mean and sd over the last 30 days).

```{r summary-table}
summaries <- lapply(names(precious_metals), function(mn) {
  tag <- paste(precious_metals[[mn]], params$currency, sep='.')
  vals <- tail(na.omit(metals.df[[tag]]), 30)
  data.frame(
    Metal = mn,
    Ticker = tag,
    LastPrice = ifelse(length(vals) > 0, round(tail(vals, 1), 2), NA),
    Mean30 = ifelse(length(vals) > 0, round(mean(vals), 2), NA),
    SD30 = ifelse(length(vals) > 0, round(sd(vals), 2), NA)
  )
})
summaries <- do.call(rbind, summaries)
print(knitr::kable(summaries, digits = 2))
```

```{r sections}
#| output: asis
metal_section <- function(metal) {
    tag <- paste(metal, params$currency, sep = '.')
    metal_name <- names(precious_metals)[precious_metals == metal]

    arima.fit <- auto.arima(tsColumn(metals.df, tag), approximation = FALSE, trace = FALSE)
    pred <- forecast(arima.fit, h = forecast.days)
    pred.df <- as.data.frame(pred)
    pred.df <- cbind(
        date = nextTradingDays(end.date, forecast.days),
        pred.df
    )
    names(pred.df) <- c('date', 'forecast', 'lo80', 'hi80', 'lo95', 'hi95')

    cat('\n\n## ', metal_name, ' (', tag, ')\n\n', sep = '')

    cat('\n\n### Price History\n\n')
    print(metalsPricePlot(metals.df, tag))

    cat('\n\n### Price Table (last 10 days)\n\n')
    print(knitr::kable(tail(metals.df[, c('date', tag)], 10), row.names = FALSE, digits = 2))

    cat('\n\n### ARIMA Forecast\n\n')
    print(arimaForecastPlot(pred, start = start.date, ylabel = tag, dates = metals.df$date))

    cat('\n\n### Forecast Table (first 10 days)\n\n')
    print(knitr::kable(head(pred.df, 10), row.names = FALSE, digits = 2))

    cat('\n\n### ARIMA Model\n\n')
    cat('\n```\n', paste(capture.output(summary(arima.fit)), collapse = '\n'), '\n```\n\n', sep = '')

    cat('\n\n### Differences Plot (log10)\n\n')
    print(metalsDiffPlot(metals.df, tag, start.date, end.date, log10 = TRUE))

    cat('\n\n### Residuals Plot\n\n')
    acf.plot <- ggAcf(ts(arima.fit$residuals), color = metals_palette[['ink']]) +
        ggtitle('ACF Residual') + theme_metals()
    pacf.plot <- ggPacf(ts(arima.fit$residuals), color = metals_palette[['ink']]) +
        ggtitle('PACF Residual') + theme_metals()
    print(acf.plot + pacf.plot)

    cat('\n\n\\newpage\n\n')
}

invisible(lapply(precious_metals, metal_section))
```
